ready1_open_rewrite.title: SciVerse open question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is the bulk polymerization and solution polymerization process of methyl methacrylate (MMA). When the MMA solution concentration is lower than 40%, the polymerization reaction does not show an autoacceleration phenomenon; when the concentration is higher than _____%, the autoacceleration phenomenon will appear.

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is the bulk polymerization and solution polymerization process of methyl methacrylate (MMA). When the MMA solution concentration is lower than 40%, the polymerization reaction does not show an autoacceleration phenomenon; when the concentration is higher than _____%, the autoacceleration phenomenon will appear.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is an MMA polymerization conversion-time curve, with the vertical axis as conversion/% and the horizontal axis as time/min. The monomer concentrations labeled beside the curves are 10%, 40%, 60%, 80%, and 100%. From the shapes of the curves, the 10% and 40% curves rise relatively gently with time, without an obvious sudden steepening; the 60% curve begins to show an obvious upward acceleration and steepening, and the accelerated rising phenomenon of 80% and 100% is more obvious. Then reason: The stem states that below 40% autoacceleration is not shown, and asks to judge above what concentration autoacceleration will appear. According to the concentration label that first shows the autoacceleration phenomenon in the figure, it is 60%, so fill in 60.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：观察转化率-时间曲线中各单体浓度标注及曲线形状，确认40%及以下曲线无明显突增，而60%曲线开始出现明显加速上升，80%和100%更明显。再结合题干“低于40%未显现自动加速，问高于多少才会出现”，取图中首次出现自动加速现象的浓度标签作为答案，即60%。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中为MMA聚合转化率-时间曲线，纵轴为转化率/%、横轴为时间/min，曲线旁标注的单体浓度有10%、40%、60%、80%、100%。从曲线形状看，10%和40%的曲线随时间较平缓上升，没有明显突然变陡；60%的曲线开始出现明显向上加速变陡，80%和100%的加速上升现象更明显。再推理：题干指出低于40%时未显现自动加速，要求判断高于多少时才会出现自动加速。根据图中首次显示自动加速现象的浓度标注为60%，因此填60。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct visual threshold-reading route: identify the first labeled concentration curve in the graph whose shape changes from ordinary smooth growth to a sharp accelerated rise, then match it to the blank. This is the natural single solution path for this graph-reading item.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the plotted MMA polymerization conversion-rate/time curves. The x-axis is time/min, y-axis is conversion rate/%, and the curves are labeled by monomer concentration: 10%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%. The 10% and 40% curves rise smoothly without an obvious sudden steepening, while the 60%, 80%, and 100% curves show a marked steep increase/autoacceleration behavior.
planner_metadata.text_role: Read the question statement: it specifies MMA solution concentration below 40% shows no autoacceleration and asks for the concentration value above which autoacceleration appears.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the polymerization graph interpretation rule that an automatic acceleration phenomenon appears as a sudden increase in curve slope/rapid rise in conversion rate. The threshold concentration is the lowest labeled concentration above the non-autoaccelerating range where this feature first appears.
